GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2020-03-26T23:36:20Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Index all but one element in an array
Description: Hello!

I have a function:
```
@jit 
remove_random_element(rng, arr):
    n = arr.shape[0]
     i = random.randint(rng, shape=(1,), minval=0, maxval=n)[0]
    indices = np.hstack((np.arange(i), np.arange(i + 1, n)))
    return arr[indices]
```
which does not work because arange tries to convert `i` into an `int` when it is an abstract value (using `astype` did not solve this.

I have tried other functional approaches such as:
```indices = np.where(np.arange(n) - i)```
but I receive a boolean indices error.

Is it possible to do this? Thanks!
